title: Import from Odoo
description: Pull catalog, stock, stock operations, and users from the saved Odoo connection. Re-running updates the same records.

help.title: About Odoo import
help.overview: The import reads Odoo over JSON-RPC using the connection saved in tenancy settings.

sections.title: What is written
sections.body: Each selected dataset is upserted by Odoo id.
items: Categories, products, variants, warehouses, on-hand stock, stock movements, internal transfers, and users.
A dry run authenticates and counts records without writing.
Imported users are invited and cannot sign in until an administrator resends the invitation.

durationWarning: A large catalog can take several minutes. Keep this page open until the import finishes.
stockOverwriteWarning: Re-running replaces warehouse on-hand quantity with Odoo's quantity. Sales recorded here since the last import are overwritten.
missingConnection: Save the Odoo server for this company before importing.
dryRunDescription: Authenticate and count records without writing.
loadError: Could not load the Odoo connection
